title: Realty Income Announces Chief Strategy Officer Transition
summary: Realty Income Announces Chief Strategy Officer Transition
body_markdown:
SAN DIEGO


, Nov. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Realty Income Corporation (Realty Income, NYSE: O), The Monthly Dividend Company®, today announced that its Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, and President of Realty Income International, Neil Abraham, will be leaving the company. To ensure a smooth transition, Mr. Abraham will continue to serve in his current role through December 31, 2026, and Realty Income intends to enter into a consulting agreement with Mr. Abraham through March 31, 2027.


"Neil has been a valued member of the senior management team and a leader for the company," said Sumit Roy, Realty Income's President and Chief Executive Officer. "On behalf of myself, the Board of Directors and the entire team at Realty Income, we want to thank Neil for his partnership and contributions to many defining moments for the company over the past 11 years, and we wish him continued success in his future endeavors."


"Being part of Realty Income's growth has been one of the great joys of my career," said Neil Abraham. "As I step into a new chapter and explore fresh opportunities, I leave feeling proud of everything we built together. I'm grateful to my colleagues, the Board and our partners for their support and trust along the way, and excited to watch Realty Income reach new heights in the years to come."


**About Realty Income**


Realty Income (NYSE: O), an S&P 500 company, is *real estate partner to the world's leading companies* ®. Founded in 1969, we serve our clients as a full-service real estate capital provider. As of September 30, 2026, we have a portfolio of over 15,500 properties in all 50 U.S. states, the U.K., and eight other countries in Europe. We are known as "The Monthly Dividend Company®" and have a mission to invest in people and places to deliver dependable monthly dividends that increase over time. Since our founding, we have declared 677 consecutive monthly dividends and are a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats® index for having increased our dividend for over 32 consecutive years. Additional information about the company can be found at[www.realtyincome.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821781-1&h=3198952211&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.realtyincome.com%2F&a=www.realtyincome.com) .
